note: 2026-11-17 comeback pack for TEAM matches only (2 or 3 units per team), from docs/agent_reports_20261117/review_round2_designer.md rows B1, B2, B3. The page (js/comeback.js) and the Python engine (scripts/comeback_py.py) must give identical numbers (shared/comeback_vectors.json). One unit per team never reads this file.

near_miss.note: OFF since 2026-11-18 (owner: damage without contact is a bug; the trace of 45,360 shots showed 61 percent of the team-match damage touched nothing with reach 450, 23 percent with 120); set enabled to true to bring it back (reach 120 px was the last value). When on: a throw that lands on the ground (no unit hit) within reach_px of the nearest living enemy box edge hits that unit for dmg x scale x (1 - e / reach_px); e = horizontal distance from the landing x to that unit's box edge; no crit, no ultimate pip, no status

underdog.note: hit damage x (1 + min(max_bonus, deficit / full_at_deficit)); deficit = max(0, enemy team HP share - own team HP share); HP share = sum of living hp / sum of max hp

pity.note: every throw of a team that deals no direct hit adds per_miss to that team's next hit (cap); a direct hit uses it and resets it; a near-miss counts as a miss for this counter

order: damage = base x weather x ramp x min(max_total_multiplier, underdog x (1 + pity)), rounded to 0.1 at the end (owner 2026-11-17: the stack was too extreme, 2.3x at most)
